reason: The official HM Land Registry National Polygon Service page is public/no-login to read and materially changes the method from council planning-register retrieval to the authoritative registered-title polygon data layer. The page states that the National Polygon dataset includes shape, polygon identification and title number, and that the Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset links title numbers to UPRNs. It also states that the service costs £20,000 plus VAT per year and requires the licence, payment and signed-in/API access. Therefore the target-specific polygon/title/UPRN record is not available inside this producer's public no-login window. No canonical parcel geometry is asserted and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
